Senses.Note: The different grammatical placements do not warrant a split: noun, modifier, and extent readings all designate completeness of the same referent. The deviation lies in the recurring public formulas 'the whole body appears' (全體現) and 'the whole body is exposed' (全體露), not in an imported claim about a metaphysical 'total reality.'
